description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5905005755118 RESISTOR,THERMAL: Line 0001 Qty 85 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0144 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
